note: BH-8736: 0 (default) = the ticket facts are retired: bin/stuck-work.sh does not call swf_ticket_facts, and the Tackler's lifecycle family (bin/lib/unblock/collectors/lifecycle.sh) watches stuck tickets from the ledger. 1 = the old ticket read runs again (rollback; bin/lib/stuck-work/facts-ticket.sh stays on the tree). Read as ${STUCK_WORK_TICKET_FACTS:-0}; any value but 1 is off.
